Iran sits astride several major faults in the earth's crust , and is prone to frequent earthquakes . In February , a quake measuring 6 . 4 on the Richter scale hit the southern town of Zarand , killing 612 people and wounding around 1 , 400 . In December 2003 , the southeastern city of Bam was razed by a 6 . 7 degree quake that left more than 31 , 000 people dead . http : / / www . xhuffingtonpost . com / 2010 / 09 / 10 / kraft - shooting - yvonne - hil _ n _ 712178 . html Kraft <8 Shooting> : Yvonne Hiller <9 Charged> With Two Counts Of <10 Murder> 09 / 10 / 10 08 : 23 PM ET A Kraft Foods plant worker who had been <11 suspended> for <12 feuding> with colleagues , then <13 escorted> from the building , <14 returned> minutes later with a handgun , <15 found> her foes in a break room and <1 executed> two of them with a single bullet each and critically <2 wounded> a third , police <17 said> Friday .
